title: Severn Bridge
visualBrief: The original M48 Severn suspension bridge: two white steel portal towers, paired inclined hangers, continuous main cables, shallow aerofoil box deck, cantilever footways, cutwater piers and concrete cable anchorages. Includes close-view cable sockets, parapets, tower saddles, access doors and four traffic lanes.

nativeAxes.origin: Main-span midpoint; localY0 accepted as an approximate global sea-plane visualization.

sourceFacts.identity: Original 1966 M48 suspension crossing, Wikidata Q1850537; not the 1996 second crossing
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Ordinary photos, preserved detailed master, explicit complete browser LODs and actual native PMTiles placement.

reconstruction.note: These are reconstruction choices, not surveyed values. The Trust gives 105 ft as approximately 35 m for deck width; 105 ft converts to 32.004 m. Short hanger angle is not published: 35 degrees is a visual reconstruction, not the explanatory 60-degree example in the source.

scaleBasis: Preserved detailed dimensions fitted approximately to the standard PMTiles crossing and inspected pictures.
geometrySource: Original deterministic Molen geometry authored from documented dimensions and construction descriptions. No downloaded mesh or photographic texture is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under the repository license. Reference publications and photographs retain their own rights and are not redistributed.
materialMethod: Shared painted-metal and concrete graphs with metric UVs; vertex colors retain the authored paint/road tints. No embedded images.
reviewStatus: Source ready for picture/PMTiles and browser-level visual review.
placementStatus: Approximate PMTiles crossing fit and global sea-plane visualization.
limitations: The 308648-triangle shared-material detailed master remains exact. Browser models preserve paired portals, connected main cables, inclined hangers, complete aerofoil roadway and footways, piers and anchorages.
Source nominal dimensions, local sea-plane datum, sag/grade and fittings remain photo/map approximations; this is not a reconciled tidal or engineering survey.

Skyline/district use representative paired hangers. Near levels retain the 344-hanger schedule, continuous cables and rails; parapet pickets are spaced 16 m on street and 2 m on closeup, while the master retains the fine original 0.75 m rhythm.

Separate Aust/Beachley/Wye approach structures use the independent native procedural bridge renderer. Their detailed unique models, current traffic, interiors, exact endpoint grades and physical device timings are outside this asset.
importReason: A 1,637.5 m envelope with 0.044 m parapet pickets, 0.05 m hangers and narrow markings loses those details under whole-object position quantization. Preserve float positions until measured segmented LOD assets are authored.

appearance.identity: Original M48 Severn suspension crossing with paired white portal towers and inclined hangers.
appearance.exclusions: Separate Aust, Beachley and Wye approach structures; certified tidal/engineering datums; interiors and traffic.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Two inspected pictures confirm white portal towers, paired inclined hangers, continuous suspension cables and a thin deck. Standard viewer PMTiles named M48 bridge roads and tower-adjacent path offsets establish the main-span midpoint and east/southeast Aust-facing native+X. Mapped tower spacing986.5m matches the retained987.5m source within about1m. The named road includes a separate eastern approach, which remains outside this1637.5m suspension/anchorage asset. LocalY0 is deliberately accepted as an approximate global sea plane; no tidal or engineering datum certification. PMTiles water masks and raw terrain provide the surrounding review fixture; physical road endpoints remain approximate.
